notes.title: DALDZAH is here!
notes.content:
[b]Bajraj[/b]!

The Daldzah has finally arrived. Now you can explore an entire mountain, return rivers to their dried riverbeds, light the stars in the broken sky, and change the foundations frozen in time. Go-go-go!

DALDZAH is made of blood, sweat, tears and most of all love from me, a solo developer, and the people around me. I hope that the joy of creation, the love, and the rays of sunshine of this little-little game will reach you, connect us all, and make you feel better.

Thanks to all of you who have connected and stayed with DALDZAH.
It seems that I may never thank you enough for this.

Have a safe journey, travelers! 
See you on the mountain 💕

notes.title: 🌙 Join Us for a Week-Long DALDZAH Demo Walkthrough at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce a week-long broadcast of the DALDZAH demo as part of the Steam Next Fest!

🌙 From 02/06/2024 to 02/12/2024 we'll take you on an exciting journey through the Ruins of Death, the abode of the Ossetian God of Death Barastyr, Tower Town, the abode of the Ingush Goddess of Land and Mountains Mehka-nan, and Sun Fields, the abode of the Abkhazian and Abazian Goddesses of Fertility and Bees, Dzhadzha and Gwynda!

⛰️ Mark your calendars, take your best hiking boots and embark on a journey through the North Caucasian collective unconscious!

🔆 Follow DALDZAH on Steam for the latest updates and join us on this unforgettable journey: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692210/DALDZAH/]DALDZAH on Steam[/url].

See you on the Mountain, travelers! 🔥✨

notes.title: 🌙 DALDZAH Demo Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
[b]Bajraj![/b]

We're thrilled to announce that the demo for our upcoming North Caucasian adventure game, [b]DALDZAH[/b], is now live on Steam, and we will be participating in Steam Next Fest with it! We're very grateful for this opportunity 💛

[b]🌙 Get the Demo Here[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692210/DALDZAH/]DALDZAH Demo[/url]

DALDZAH has been a year in the making and we can't wait for you to get a taste of what it has to offer. The demo consists of the first 3 levels: Ruins of the Death, Tower City, and Sun Fields, just waiting for you to enter!

[b]🌙 We Need Your Feedback[/b]
As we continue to fine-tune DALDZAH for its full release, we're eager to hear your thoughts and suggestions. Your feedback will play a vital role in shaping the final version of the game, ensuring it becomes the unforgettable adventure we envision it to be.
Fill the form to leave your feedback: [url=[url=https://forms.gle/SdQs2RGz7mUJouhYA]Google Form[/url]]DALDZAH Demo Feedback Google Form[/url]

[b]✨ How to Play the DALDZAH Demo[/b]
[list]
[*] Visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692210/DALDZAH/]Steam store page[/url]
[*] Click the "Download Demo" button
[/list]
Thank you for your support and enthusiasm as we embark on this incredible journey together. Share your feedback, screenshots, and stories from your adventure with us and the community!

See you on the Mountain, traveller! ❤️‍🔥
